From: Brice Semmens [sem...@ucsd.edu]
Sent: 10 December 2016 01:47
Subject: know a good quantitative postdoc prospect?

Greetings All --

I'm looking for a postdoc to bring strong quantitative skills/tools to bear on a world-class ocean time series (CalCOFI -- https://www.calcofi.org/).

The postdoc job announcement can be found here:
http://postdocservices.ucsd.edu/PostDocOpp/Job/Details/1078

There isn't any specific preconceived question to address (although suggested topics are included in the announcement). I'm hoping to find someone that can work with my lab and the community here to identify the exciting questions, and execute the analyses necessary to answer them. Given the nature of the data, exceptional temporal and spatial analysis skills are prized. While a background in marine ecology would be ideal, it is not strictly necessary.

If you know someone that might suit the position, please pass on the announcement. Please also feel free to circulate this email or the announcement to colleagues.

Warmly,
Brice Semmens
